# commonmark-0.31.2 12 Backslash escapes
```````````````````````````````` example
\!\"\#\$\%\&\'\(\)\*\+\,\-\.\/\:\;\<\=\>\?\@\[\\\]\^\_\`\{\|\}\~
.
<p>!&quot;#$%&amp;'()*+,-./:;&lt;=&gt;?@[\]^_`{|}~</p>
````````````````````````````````

# commonmark-0.31.2 13 Backslash escapes
```````````````````````````````` example
\→\A\a\ \3\φ\«
.
<p>\→\A\a\ \3\φ\«</p>
````````````````````````````````

# commonmark-0.31.2 15 Backslash escapes
```````````````````````````````` example
\\*emphasis*
.
<p>\<em>emphasis</em></p>
````````````````````````````````

# commonmark-0.31.2 16 Backslash escapes
```````````````````````````````` example

bar
.
<p>foo<br />
bar</p>
````````````````````````````````

# commonmark-0.31.2 17 Backslash escapes
```````````````````````````````` example

.
````````````````````````````````
